Good to know

Clear expectations before you begin.

A few practical boundaries help you plan the right deployment, licences and support.

01

Cloud connectivity is required

Velldot runs in the browser and needs an internet connection. It is not an offline ERP or POS.

02

Modules depend on licence and setup

Availability follows your organization’s licences and configuration. POS posts to Finance only when Finance is licensed and mapped.

03

Onboarding can be scoped

Overdott can help define onboarding and support around your modules, configuration and rollout.

Scope note: Velldot does not currently provide consolidated multi-company accounting or live SSO, AI or Zoho integrations.

Frequently asked questions

The practical details, upfront.

Understand product status, module administration, payments and deployment boundaries before you begin.

Contact Overdott ↗
What is Velldot ERP?

Velldot ERP is a product initiative by Overdott. The verified build is a web-based ERP built on Django, with modular organization workspaces, tenant-scoped business rows and separate tools for tenant owners and platform administrators. Commercial availability is confirmed by enquiry.

Which business modules are included in the verified build?

The verified build includes Projects, Finance, Procurement, Sales & CRM, Human Resources, Inventory, Helpdesk, Assets, Point of Sale and Signatures. The modules enabled for an organization depend on licensing and configuration.

Can we register for a trial?

You can register interest for early access. The verified application includes configurable signup and trial flows, but public access, trial duration and terms depend on the deployment. Overdott confirms whether a trial is available for your requirements.

Who manages users, billing and module licences?

Tenant owners manage users, billing, renewals and domains. Module licence changes are restricted to platform administrators; tenant owners do not change module licences themselves.

How are pricing and payments handled?

This corporate website does not publish prices or edition names. Pricing, licensing and payment availability are confirmed with Overdott. The verified application supports Stripe Checkout and M-Pesa STK Push for authenticated renewals when those options are configured.

Which Kenya-oriented workflows are supported?

eTIMS transport and retry queues are available when configured, and queue processing requires a worker. M-Pesa STK Push is available for authenticated renewals when configured, with M-Pesa also available as a payment option in supported workflows.

Can Velldot ERP or Point of Sale work offline?

No. Velldot is a cloud application and requires internet connectivity. It is not an offline ERP or POS.

Does Point of Sale post to Finance automatically?

Only when the Finance module is licensed and mapped. POS configuration should be confirmed during onboarding so the intended finance workflow is clear.

What reporting and access controls are included?

PDF and CSV reporting are available across modules. Verified controls include TOTP MFA, login throttling, audit middleware, security headers and private tenant-media checks. These controls should be considered alongside your own access and deployment requirements.

Can Overdott help with onboarding and support?

Yes. Onboarding and support can be scoped with Overdott around your chosen modules, configuration, rollout and team requirements.
